messages:
sre-bot: [ALERT] Canary deployment 'inference-v14' -> prod namespace. Observed 47 x CrashLoopBackOff on inference-pod replicas in prod-us-west2 cluster. Error: OOMKilled and failing readiness probes.

alex: paging oncall (maria) — looks like the canary rollout just hit traffic.

maria: on it. pulling logs now. any recent manifest changes?

jon: deploy-bot shows the canary was pushed 5m ago by ryan — image: redwood/inference:v14.

ryan: I pushed a small resource patch to HPA/Deployment to test autoscaling for short-lived bursts. did not expect OOM.

maria: logs from one pod: 
```
panic: runtime: out of memory
2026-03-15T13:07:02Z stderr F allocation failed
```
readiness probe failing: HTTP 500 on /healthz.

alex: can we instantly switch traffic off to the canary? any feature flag to kill?

ryan: yes there's a gateway flag `canary-inference-v14` in LaunchDarkly. toggling now.

ryan: toggled flag -> OFF :white_check_mark:. traffic should stop flowing to the canary within ~10s.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary routing removed. Current traffic -> stable inference-v12.

maria: good. pods stopped receiving new traffic but still crashlooping during startup — need to prevent restarts to avoid noise and node pressure. Proposing to scale canary replicas to 0.

jon: agree. `kubectl scale deploy inference-canary --replicas=0 -n prod`

maria: running: 
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy inference-canary --replicas=0
kubectl -n prod get pods | grep inference-canary
```

maria: scaled to 0 :white_check_mark:. pods terminating. node pressure easing.

tammy: customer impact? any 5xx spikes surfaced to customers?

alex: initial metric blip. A subset of requests during the 5m window saw increased latency and ~0.8% 502s on public API. Top customers: two mid-market customers reported degraded responses. CS is looped in.

tammy: opening a support ticket for the affected customers. tagging CS @cs-team.

ryan: root cause hypothesis: HPA misconfig + lowered memory requests caused kube to schedule pods with insufficient resources and container runtime OOM. The config change used a lighter request to improve bin-packing but didn't account for cold-start memory spikes with KV cache warmup.

maria: agree. I pulled the canary manifest diff — memory requests dropped from 16Gi -> 8Gi. that's the culprit.

alex: can we roll forward with a fix or roll back the rollout? What's safer?

maria: rollback to inference-v12 for canary was automatic since we removed routing. But we should patch the deployment manifest to restore requests and run a controlled canary. I'd prefer patch + small canary (1 pod) in a drained node pool to observe.

jon: also HPA target was set to CPU% 85 — should be 60 for inference. misconfig. I'll open a PR to revert both HPA and resource requests.

ryan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-deploy/pull/482 — includes request=16Gi and HPA target 60%. CI green.

deploy-bot: PR merged by jon. New revision inference-v14-patch deployed to staging.

maria: before promoting, let's run a canary in staging and run perf test: `ab -n 500 -c 20 http://staging-inference/healthz` and memory monitoring.

alex: oncall handoff: maria -> jon in 20m. jon will continue monitoring until full rollback/patch is confirmed.

jon: acknowledged. taking over pager. I'll watch nodes and pod restarts.

maria: summary for incident ticket: 
- timeline: canary deploy v14 started -> 13:07, observed CrashLoopBackOff due to OOM -> 13:10; feature flag kill-switch toggled -> 13:12; scaled canary replicas to 0 -> 13:14; customer 502 spike (~0.8%) observed, CS notified.
- impact: transient 502s for some customer requests, no data loss, degraded latency for 5-7 minutes.
- root cause: bad manifest change (memory requests lowered) + aggressive HPA threshold.
- mitigation: kill-switch toggled, canary scaled to 0, PR reverted resource changes, staging canary tests planned.

tammy: adding postmortem owners: maria (ops lead), ryan (author of change), jon (oncall followup).

alex: thanks everyone. please add any logs or gcp console links to the incident ticket. I'll run a short retrospective tomorrow to tighten canary gating. :eyes:

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-089 — assigned to incidents. Include timeline and severity P2.

jon: I'll stay on monitor for 30m then hand back. leaving a watch on the dashboards.

maria: handing off to jon now. heading for quick break.

jon: taking over — ping me if any regression.

tammy: CS: ticket created and customers notified. will follow up once remediation confirmed.

alex: closing slack loop once incident ticket updated with all artifacts. great response team. :thumbsup:
